flora: Simple oval leaf (close-up showing a serrated, jagged margin and a prominent central vein)
Primitive flower cluster (tiny, inconspicuous green-white blossoms bundled tightly on a branch node)
Smooth bark section (macro view of light grey bark with scattered, raised breathing pores)
Young seedling (sturdy, upright woody shoot with a pair of thick, waxy cotyledon leaves)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on small-scale botanical anatomy; leaf margins must look distinctly jagged but smooth-edged; avoid complex flower configurations; emphasize thick, tactile plant tissues.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout: Top-Left: a single, crisp oval leaf showcasing jagged margins; Top-Right: a bundle of tiny primitive flower clusters along a branch; Bottom-Left: a macro study of the smooth grey bark surface; Bottom-Right: a stout young seedling emerging cleanly.
visual_logic.ground: A uniform backdrop of damp, rich silt brown clay, providing a clean, distraction-free stage for the specimens.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused daylight to illuminate internal vein logic and flower clusters without creating high-contrast shadows.
